data.body:
SPLIT into a two-PR stack 2026-07-29, after review feedback that the single PR was too large (25 files, +1624/-161; our guidance is 200-500 lines, 500 max).

- DRAFT PR #823 https://github.com/navapbc/oscer/pull/823 'Enforce the verification data source outcome contract', base main, branch giverm/OSCER-805-data-source-outcome-contract, commit cfd070cd. 6 files, +203/-6. Verification::DataSource#call runtime ContractError + Determination::EXCEPTION_OUTCOME_KEYS/CE_OUTCOME_KEYS + loader boot validation of the partition. Stands alone: suite 3053 ex / 0 fail, RuboCop clean (568 files). Independently valuable because it also hardens the exclusion path #808 already made live.
- DRAFT PR #822 https://github.com/navapbc/oscer/pull/822 retargeted onto #823's branch, force-pushed to commit 127ea5c1. 23 files, +1443/-177. The wiring: trailing verification_data_source_check step, negative relocation, MockCommunityEngagement, reachability guard, shared assess extraction, spec-helper dedup. Suite 3161 ex / 0 fail, RuboCop clean (576 files).

Split method: built the foundation branch off origin/main, pulled the six relevant files from the wiring branch, then removed forward references so the foundation is self-consistent (CALCULATION_TYPE_DATA_SOURCE_CE out of determination.rb, the hybrid-source gap note out of the loader since it describes a consumer that does not exist there yet, and the mock_community_engagement registration assertions out of the loader spec). Rebuilt the wiring on top and verified the combined tree is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-split branch for app/config/spec, so the split is lossless.

Both branches are on latest main (705d47e7, the #821 dependency bundle). NOTE: that bundle bumped csv/aws-sdk/simplecov/aws-partitions, so a local 'make build' is required before lint or specs will run on either branch; the pre-split branch predated it and did not need one.

Considered and DECLINED a third split (exception path + negative relocation, then CE attestation + mock). The seam is clean since data_source_check_service_spec is organised by context, but it yields ~970 + ~650 lines, so only one slice lands near target, and it needs surgery inside a service and a 501-line spec. The wiring PR's production diff is only ~280 lines across 9 files; the bulk is three new spec files a reviewer reads once. Michael's call: stop at two.

Review order for Jeff: #823 first, then #822. After #823 merges, #822's base changes to main.
